description:
Yaroslav Askarov, the sole goaltender selected in the first round of the 2020 NHL Draft, recorded his first career win with a shootout victory over the Washington Capitals.  In the first sequence of the highlight with a tie score and under two minutes remaining in the second period, Askarov comes up with a big save on Beck Malenstyn who was trying to take advantage of a Nashville turnover right in the slot.  Later on during the shootout, Askarov delivered two crucial saves against Evgeny Kuznetsov and Alex Ovechkin, ensuring the victory. His performance, including 26 saves and the pivotal shootout stops, rightfully earned him the first star of the game accolade.

description:
In his fifth NHL appearance, Ivan Miroshnichenko, the Capitals' first-round pick in the 2022 NHL Draft, netted his first career goal. Miroshnichenko was diagnosed with Hodgkin's lymphoma during his draft season in 2022 but completed treatment and returned to the ice later that year and broke into the NHL in 2023-24. With quick hands, Miroshnichenko maneuvered around the goalie and tucked the puck into the far side of the net.

description:
Playing in just his second career NHL game and on his 21st birthday, Logan Stankoven notched his first career goal. description:
The eight overall pick from the 2021 NHL Draft, defenseman Brandt Clarke scored his first career goal in dramatic fashion. As the Kings’ penalty expired in overtime, Phillip Danault intercepted a Boston cross-ice pass attempt and sent it up the ice. With a nice backhand-to-forehand deke getting the goalie to bite, he tucked it in for the game winner.

description:
In the opening minutes of the game, rookie goaltender Jesper Wallstedt quickly found his rhythm, stopping a shot amidst traffic without yielding a rebound. His performance continued into the second period, denying Alex Vlasic's close-range attempt with a deft save. Later in the same period, Wallstedt made another stop through a partial screen and kicked out the rebound clear of danger. The culmination of his performance came with his first career win, capped off in style with a flawless 24-save shutout.
